adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in a try/catch that logs only a static string and discards the caught error: `catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`. The mutation then returns success (`return { message: "Guests added" };`) regardless of email delivery outcome, so failures are not diagnosable and the client will still see a successful add even if notifications failed. This is a concrete observability/UX issue introduced by the diff, though core guest-adding logic still succeeds.
